newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - June 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on June 17:
WASHINGTON - The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is sticking to its original proposal to allow broad, on-demand deactivation of air bags.

WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration will not support new laws to regulate material on the Internet and instead will advocate the use of technology that allows users to screen what children, for instance, can access on the global computer network.
WASHINGTON - Regional technology firms are strutting their stuff before big-time investors.

WASHINGTON - Genesis Health Ventures Inc. joined forces with two investment funds in a deal to purchase Multicare Cos. for $1.4 billion, creating an elder care network from New Hampshire to the Washington area.
